objectives: Recognise sw at the beginning of taught words.
Decode and spell taught sw-words accurately.
Read controlled sw-sentences and explain literal meaning.
Use diagnostic evidence to identify a skill for targeted review.
concepts: A diagnostic samples several related skills.
Accurate decoding preserves every sound in a word.
Fluency combines accuracy and appropriate phrasing.
A weak component guides targeted practice.

definitions.definition: An assessment used to identify current strengths and learning needs.
Accurate reading with appropriate pace and phrasing.
Noticing an error and repairing it by checking the word again.

workedExamples.solution: Swim begins with sw; slip begins with sl.

activities.name: Complete the sw skill check
steps: Review the target skill and a worked example.
Complete a guided example and explain the sound or text evidence.
Reread or recheck and repair any mismatch.

activities.name: Find the error and repair a fresh item.
steps: Review a sample response with one target-skill error.
Identify the sound, grapheme, or evidence that does not match.
Correct the response and explain why.
Complete a fresh item without the model or answer key.
